name: Get a link's thumbnail
description: The link's thumbnail as a 640×360 WebP image. The server starts generating it in the background when the link is created, from the page's og:image or a screenshot, so expect 404 for a few seconds after a create. If generation fails, this keeps returning 404. The mock backend doesn't generate thumbnails and always answers 404.

responses.description: OK. The body is the image itself, not JSON.
The link has no thumbnail yet, or generation failed. (An unknown link id also returns 404, with the usual NOT_FOUND message.)

error.message: This link has no thumbnail yet.
